title: Nonnegativity of the expected square of a smoothed Boolean function
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function and let $\rho\in\bbr$ be arbitrary. Applying the noise operator $T_\rho$ to $f$ and averaging the square over the uniform measure gives a nonnegative quantity:
\[
  \E\!\left[(T_\rho f)^2\right]\;\ge\;0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean function f of arity n
replaced: For any $\rho$ and Boolean function $f$, $\E[(T_\rho f)^2] \ge 0$.
